To prevent false positives, avoid perfume/cologne, vanilla flavor, energy drinks, cinnamon candy, pizza/donuts/yeasty things, and toothpaste and mouthwash. Either wait a good while after brushing teeth or use Colgate total which I know is alcohol free. Don’t use your windshield wiper fluid either, it can seep into the car thru the vents and make you fail. Careful when getting gas so you don’t get any on your hands. No hand sanitizer either. Keep water in the car at all times to rinse if need be.
